metadata.description: Real-time PowerShell diagnostics for Claude Code -- standalone distribution of the powershell-lsp plugin.

plugins.name: powershell-lsp
plugins.description: Real-time PowerShell diagnostics in Claude Code: as Claude edits a .ps1/.psm1/.psd1, it runs PowerShell Editor Services + PSScriptAnalyzer over that file and surfaces syntax errors and lint fixes inline. Hover, go-to-definition, and find-references serve natively through an opt-in handshake shim (userConfig nativeServe, off by default).
